name: Low pogo hops
why: Quick, springy ankles help you bounce into your set position. They also help you leave the ground fast.

setup.surface_note: Wooden floor, carpet over a firm floor, a thick mat or grass. Never on concrete or tiles laid on concrete.
setup.parent: Stand in front, about 2 m away, and listen to the landings.

steps: Stand tall, feet hip width, arms relaxed.
Make small quick hops, a few centimetres high, mostly from the ankles.
Land softly on the balls of the feet, knees a little bent.
Count each landing, stop at the set's number and rest.

mistakes.fix: Keep the hops low; quick matters, not high.
Stay on the balls of the feet and land quietly.
Keep the knees over the toes and slow down.

stop_if: Pain in the heel, shin, ankle or below the kneecap
Chest pain, a racing heartbeat or unusual shortness of breath
Landings turn loud or the knees cave in (end the set)

easier.variant: Heel raises: rise onto the toes and lower slowly, no hop.

harder.variant: Small hops forward and back over a line on the floor.
harder.move_on_when: Every rep clean two sessions in a row, and the owner approves.

dose.tempo: quick and light, like the floor is hot
